{{Quote|Yes, sir, we have its ID signature... it's not in our databanks, but its profile suggests some low stock freighter... says it's being hit hard by a Sith warship.|The Harbinger's Navigation Officer speaking to The [[Harbinger Captain|Harbinger's Captain]] about the ''Ebon Hawk''|<ref name="KOTOR2" />}}
This soldier served aboard the [[Harbinger (Hammerhead-class)|''Harbinger'']] as its Navigation [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] in [[3951 BBY]].

==Biography==
She served up until her death during [[Darth Sion]]{{'s}} takeover of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] along with his [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith Assassins]]. [[Meetra Surik]] discovered a series of [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of the officer where she spoke with the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] about a mysterious vessel, the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'', and its passengers.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
